justification: Panel A depicts a small crouching quadruped animal (with a faint outline of another animal beside it), while Panel B depicts a human male head and shoulders in profile wearing an elaborate patterned headdress and fringed garment. There is no shared subject matter, no comparable relationships between elements, and no similar arrangement; the only faint commonality is a generally schematic, low-relief carving convention with textured/incised surface detail.
